changes: Fresh ACTIVE actor membership and owned active deal/related account/stage locks within writes; reject stale expectedUpdatedAt and keep monotonic versions.

UUID creation receipt, recovery GET and cancellation DELETE; replay before quota, creation receipt and quota within one Serializable transaction; only fresh creation records usage. Soft-deleted targets retain receipt and cannot resurrect.
Strict non-truncating text/date/related-ID/field validation. Existing documented amount rounding is preserved; client no longer converts malformed amount to zero or strips characters.
Stage outcome transitions clear opposite timestamps, preserve same-outcome closed date and never move lastActivityAt backwards. Historical customer rows are not bulk modified.

Whole-transaction retries recognize model serialization errors and raw SQLSTATE40001/40P01; only receipt key conflict in an explicitly opted-in Serializable create retries the whole operation. Bounded5 attempts; unrelated unique/SQL errors do not retry.
Actual deal page uses shared bounded transport, actor/org/epoch guards, synchronous lanes and metadata-only recovery. All create/edit/stage consumers adopted; no optimistic unconfirmed stage move.

Draft revision and modal epochs retain newer input; same-actor authentication loading retains forms. Stage/edit operations send expectedUpdatedAt. Unknown outcome remains fenced until current state is confirmed or uncommitted creation is atomically cancelled.
limitations: No production DB/customer/provider/billing writes. Local PG schema and auth are synthetic; complete production FK behavior not proven.
Mounted fixture mocks Next navigation/auth/API; actual browser, drag interactions and private production persistence remain unproven.
Legacy clients omitting operation/version remain explicitly supported; distinct new UUIDs from separate tabs/devices remain separate intent. Metadata does not survive closing the tab.
A concurrent mutable list may change during pagination; no snapshot completeness guarantee.
Historical contradictory outcome timestamps are not bulk corrected; display accepts legacy nullable dates while newly created/stage-changed outcomes must be coherent.
Other SFA accounts/contacts/leads/conversion/settings/provider lifecycle and all17 services/2074 criteria remain incomplete.
